lines: COMMITS on track/p-offline-recovery, author tamagami-hi, no trailers, nothing amended: 981ff23 fix(offline): clear the banner and re-read failed reads on reconnect; 7f08114 fix(offline): fail offline writes fast and probe whenever degraded (review of 981ff23, .temp/p-offline-recovery/review.md, items 1-4).

FILES: app/providers/NetworkStatusProvider.tsx (+test), app/providers/QueryProvider.tsx (+test, added to lane by the coordinator), api/failedReads.ts (new, shared helper), ui/patterns/AsyncBoundary.tsx, app/native/ConnectivityBanner.tsx. Not touched: AppProviders, shells, android, SipDetailScreen, TransportReporter, useHeldWrite.

CAUSE (U3): degraded read the last transport outcome, and only a 2xx cleared it. TanStack's onlineManager starts online and only changes on window events, so after a reload while offline (or an outage only the transport saw) its reconnect refetch never fires.

RECOVERY: the online event clears an offline/timeout outcome at once. On the degraded->clear edge, every active query in error is re-read (api/failedReads.ts refetchFailedReads: refetchQueries type active, status error, cancelRefetch false). A lost re-read shows the banner again. Any server answer counts as reachable.

PROBE (7f08114: whenever degraded, not only when the device reports online): every 10 s while the document is visible it re-reads qk.app.config (unauthenticated, retry false, mounted by AppNoticeGate in both shells). The first answer counts as the connection returning. The interval is cleared on recovery and unmount; it is skipped while hidden. This covers a lost online event and an APK WebView without network notices.

TRY AGAIN (U9): AsyncBoundary (ErrorState and stale notice, the shared failure component on 87 screens) runs the query's own refetch, then refetchFailedReads. SIP detail re-reads plan and fund list together.

NETWORK MODE (7f08114, rule 6): createQueryClient now sets networkMode 'always' for mutations, as asked. Mutation retry stays false; grep finds no useMutation overriding retry or networkMode. An offline write fails fast into the held Not confirmed state, is not resumed by TanStack on the online event, and goes out again only on Check again with the same Idempotency-Key.

BEYOND THE ASK, please check: queries also got networkMode 'always'. Without it, after a browser offline event TanStack pauses every query fetch, so the probe (and any read) is never sent while the online event is lost, and item 2 would not work. Side effect: in the browser, a read made after an offline event shows its failure panel ('No connection', Try again) instead of a paused skeleton (rule 4). The paused admin-funds re-read noted in r-fx-admin-funds-2 goes the same way.

COPY: 'BeOnEdge cannot be reached. Nothing has been lost. This screen updates once the connection is back, and anything marked Not confirmed waits for you to check it.' It is generic because the client's Not confirmed notes say to reload, not Check again.

COMPAT (rule 11): frontend only. No API, contract, storage or token change. The only new traffic is GET /v1/app-config at most every 10 s while the banner shows and the app is visible. Released APKs and the rollback target are unaffected. ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE precondition: met by 7f08114 (writes cannot pause, so the online event cannot auto-send them).

DOUBT 2: the probe relies on qk.app.config being in the cache (AppNoticeGate wraps every route). Each failed active query costs up to 3 transport attempts x 3 TanStack attempts per recovery or Try again; paged queries refetch every loaded page.

COMMIT 981ff23 fix(offline): clear the banner and re-read failed reads on reconnect (track/p-offline-recovery, one commit, author tamagami-hi, no trailers). Files: app/providers/NetworkStatusProvider.tsx (+test), app/native/ConnectivityBanner.tsx, ui/patterns/AsyncBoundary.tsx. Not touched: AppProviders, shells, android, SipDetailScreen, QueryProvider, TransportReporter.

CAUSE (U3): degraded read the last transport outcome; only a 2xx cleared it. TanStack's refetchOnReconnect is on, but its onlineManager starts online and only changes on window events, so after a reload while offline (or an outage only the transport saw) the online event is a no-op and nothing re-reads.

FIX 1: state is {deviceOnline, lastOutcome}. The window online event clears an offline/timeout outcome at once (banner hides) and, on the degraded->clear transition, refetchQueries({type:'active', predicate: status==='error'}, {cancelRefetch:false}). A re-read lost as offline reports offline again, so the banner returns. Any server answer (2xx, http, malformed, maintenance) now counts as reachable; before, a 401 or 500 left it up.

FIX 1b (probe): while degraded and the device still reports online (no online event will come), every 10 s while the document is visible it re-reads the app-config query (qk.app.config, unauthenticated, retry:false, mounted by AppNoticeGate in both shells). The first answer clears the banner and triggers the same failed-read refetch. Stops when the banner clears or the device reports offline; skipped while hidden.

WHY THE PROBE: the merged APK manifest (android/app/build/intermediates/merged_manifests, 0.18.2 build) has no ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE. I believe Android WebView only tracks connectivity (navigator.onLine, online/offline events) with that permission, so on the APKs the online event may never fire. UNVERIFIED; the emulator step below checks it.

FIX 2 (U9): AsyncBoundary's Try again (ErrorState and the stale notice) now calls the query's own refetch and then re-reads every active query in error (cancelRefetch:false). It is the shared failure component (87 screens). SIP detail's Try again comes from it, so the fund list is re-read with the plan. SipDetailScreen itself is unchanged.

COPY: banner now reads 'BeOnEdge cannot be reached. Nothing has been lost, and this screen updates once the connection is back.' It is true on both paths (event, or probe within 10 s). The old copy said 'You are offline ... we will retry', which was false.

HELD WRITES (rule 6): only queries are refetched; the mutation cache, useHeldWrite and unsettledHeldWrites are untouched, and onlineManager is not driven, so no paused or held write is resumed. Held saves stay 'Not confirmed' until Check again (same key). STATIC.

COMPAT (rule 11): frontend only. No API, contract, storage or token change, and no new request shape. The only new traffic is GET /v1/app-config at most every 10 s while the banner shows and the app is visible (the same endpoint already polls every 30 s under maintenance). Released APKs and the rollback target are unaffected.

TESTS (rule 10) in NetworkStatusProvider.test.tsx, a fake transport through TransportReporter with no browser offline event (the emulator case): (1) the online event clears the offline state before any request answers: red 20261118T064341Z-3129526; (2) the online event re-reads the failed query, a lost re-read shows offline again, the next online event plus an answer recovers: red 20261118T064344Z-3131329; (3) the probe fires at 10 s (not at 9.999 s) and re-reads only the config, and an answer clears the state and re-reads the plan: red 20261118T064348Z-3134071.

RED METHOD: NetworkStatusProvider.tsx reverted alone to 981ff23^, each test run on its own with -t, the file restored and checked identical with cmp, tree clean. No existing test asserted the old behaviour, so none was changed. No test for the AsyncBoundary retry or the copy (rule 10, not requested).

EMU CLIENT A (U3): open /sips/<id> and wait for the fund-name heading. Turn airplane mode ON. In DevTools, read navigator.onLine and note it (true means the WebView gets no network notices). Reload the WebView. Expect 'No connection / Try again' within about 10 s and the amber banner with the new copy. The network log shows GET /v1/app-config every ~10 s (3 attempts each), nothing else on a timer.

EMU CLIENT A cont.: turn airplane mode OFF and do not touch the screen. Measure the time to banner gone, and to the plan shown with the fund name in the heading (not 'Fund'). Expect about 1 s to the banner and 1-3 s to the data if the online event fires; otherwise 12 s or less after the network is usable (one probe tick plus a round trip). Never about 50 s. If the first re-read fails, the banner returns and clears at the next tick.

EMU CLIENT B (U9 Try again): with airplane mode still ON on /sips/<id> after a reload, tap Try again. The network log should show both client/sips and client/funds?limit=25 (plus any other failed reads) on that tap. Then turn it OFF and tap Try again before the banner clears: the heading shows the fund name.
EMU CLIENT C: background the app while offline. No app-config requests arrive while it is hidden. Bring it back after reconnecting: it recovers on resume or within 10 s.

EMU ADMIN A: open /content/faqs. Turn airplane mode ON, edit and save an FAQ: it is held as 'Not confirmed' and the banner shows. Turn it OFF and do not touch the screen: the banner clears in 12 s or less (about 1 s with events). The network log shows only GETs (app-config and failed reads), no POST, PUT or PATCH. The save stays 'Not confirmed' until Check again, which sends the same Idempotency-Key.
EMU ADMIN B: open /users/<id>. Turn airplane mode ON and reload: an error panel with Try again. Turn it OFF and do not touch: the page loads by itself within the same timing.

DOUBT 1 (needs android/** owner or maintainer): if navigator.onLine stays true in airplane mode, add <uses-permission android:name="android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE"/> to AndroidManifest. It is a normal, auto-granted permission, but it changes the APK permission list. It would make recovery immediate and would also make the existing online-event retries in SessionProvider (deep-URL restore) and SplashScreen (reachability) work on the APK; today they may never fire there.
DOUBT 2: the probe relies on the app-config query being in the cache (AppNoticeGate wraps every route in both shells). With no active query at all, nothing would probe.

LEFT 1 (rule 4): SIP detail still shows 'Fund' silently if the fund list fails while the plans load (nameFor fallback). Fixing it means UI in SipDetailScreen, which p-shell-polish edits; suggest the FundNames 'Fund name unavailable' pattern in a later lane.
LEFT 2: a loadAll paged list whose later page failed (a page hold, api/paged.ts) is re-read, but its hold is released only by its own Try again. Fund catalogue pages are 25 rows.

OBSERVATION (pre-existing, browser only, not changed): after a browser offline event, TanStack's onlineManager pauses new fetches, which show a skeleton, and resumes paused mutations on reconnect. A write tapped while the browser says offline is sent on reconnect without a second tap, with its key and as a first send. Worth a maintainer reading against rule 6.
EVIDENCE: TESTED (unit), STATIC (held writes, copy). RUNTIME UNVERIFIED: no browser or emulator run here. What's new notes are left to the coordinator.
